Gurke.et: Borrowed from Old Polish ogórek, from Medieval Greek ἀγγούριον (angoúrion, “cucumber”). Cognate with Dutch augurk, English gherkin.

Gürteltier.et: Gürtel (“belt”) + Tier (“animal”). Displaced the earlier term Armadill (from Spanish armadillo), which had itself displaced Tatu (from Old Tupi).
